# Lean Forward

> Surf coaching, guided surf tours and surf & nature adventures based in
> Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica. Founded and run by Mateo, a coach who
> learned to surf on Tamarindo Beach after moving there from Colombia at 13.

Lean Forward runs personalized surf coaching for beginners through advanced
surfers, guided tours to surf spots across the Guanacaste coast, and custom
multi-day surf-and-nature itineraries across Costa Rica. Sessions are built
around each guest's goals, level and schedule. All experiences are booked
directly by WhatsApp or email; there is no online booking engine.

- Location: Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica
- WhatsApp: +506 7244-6227
- Email: contact.leanforward@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/leanforwardsurf/
- Hours: available daily by appointment; replies usually within a few hours

## Experiences and prices (USD, per person unless noted)

- The Foundation — private & small-group surf coaching in Tamarindo.
  Private session, 2 h: $100. Semi-private, 2 h: $90 per person. Group
  coaching, 2 h: $80 per person. All prices include the 13% tax.
  Board, ocean safety briefing and personalized feedback included.
- The Exploration — guided surf tours, 3 hours, from $130. Spots include
  Playa Avellanas, Playa Grande, Guiones and Marbella; chosen on the day
  based on conditions. Board, snacks and hydration included.
- The Immersion — private surf & nature experiences in Guanacaste, from $230
  per person, custom-priced (group size, surf sessions, destination,
  activities, transportation) with a personalized quote before booking. Combines coaching with waterfalls,
  volcanic landscapes and local experiences.
- The Signature Progression Week — a special package, multi-day or multi-week structured coaching for
  travelers staying in Tamarindo. Priced on request. Can include video
  analysis, surf theory, wave reading, yoga, massage and a written
  progression plan.
